Geographies Served Programs Women Empowerment State Karnataka States Karnataka Extends support for vulnerable women by offering them safety and aid. Assure the women who have been rescued of receiving basic necessities including food, clothing, and shelter; also, provide them with critical medical and psychological treatment. Our main goal is to empower people via skill development training so they may become independent again and create a better future for themselves. Education and Child Care State Karnataka States Karnataka Supports kids from disadvantaged and vulnerable homes, including kids with special needs. ensures they receive medical and psychological help in addition to providing them with necessities like food, clothing, and shelter. Give their education a priority by placing them in regular classrooms or offering bridge instruction. We provide a residential school for special needs kids where they get specialized instruction from qualified teachers. Senior Care State Karnataka States Karnataka Runs two assisted living facilities, providing devoted care for elderly people in need. Providing for their basic needs—such as food, clothing, and shelter—is our main priority. makes certain they get the medical attention and psychological assistance they require. We strive to create productive and fulfilling experiences for them by providing skill development programs and engaging leisure activities in addition to meeting their fundamental needs. Environment and Ecology We have been exeucting planataion of trees in Government Lands in Karnataka.
